_about: The investor questions Ask DeepGrid answers with a written brief. scripts/build-briefs.mjs retrieves evidence for each from the GraphRAG index, has a model write a structured, cited brief, and drops any point whose figures its sources do not contain. `title` is the routing key (the eval and theme-examples refer to it); `ask` is the chip; `examples` are extra phrasings used for routing (never copied from scripts/ask-routing-eval.json); `sections` pins memorandum sections that must be in the evidence; `products` are the dossiers the answer offers. Written 18 Sep 2026.
